title: Distributional Calibration and Conditional-Median Point Forecast
mission: Calibrate the final residual distribution, quantiles and threshold probabilities; use the calibrated conditional median as the MAE-oriented point forecast.
steps: Fit EMOS/GAMLSS/quantile and conformal candidates using OOF residuals.
Condition scale on ensemble spread, expert disagreement, regime and recent error.
Compare final P50 to router point and official baseline on MAE.
Report CRPS, pinball, Brier and calibration.
acceptance: P50 point is no worse than router beyond tolerance and probabilities calibrated
Otherwise keep router point and distribution separately
failure: Small-sample regime scale models shrink to global
